headline: Make room for yourself.
intro: Step away from the everyday and come back to yourself. Our yoga retreats bring good movement, nourishing food, fresh air and real connection together in one beautiful pause.
hero_alt: Vanessa Flow Yoga retreat guests walking together in the countryside
story_heading: More than time on the mat.
story: Expect a balance of energising and restorative yoga, shared meals, new experiences and space to do exactly what you need. Come with a friend or come on your own. Beginners are welcome.
past_heading: Where the journey has taken us
past_description: Our Alive and Aglow retreat brought the group together for yoga, nature, nourishing food and time to reconnect in the Welsh mountains.
quote: Vanessa's retreats are very special. She creates such a beautiful environment that gives people flexibility to do whatever they want to do.
interest_heading: Be first to hear what comes next.
interest_description: There is no retreat on sale right now. Leave your details and we'll email you when the next one is announced.
